notes.title: "Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune" will release a new DEMO during Steam
notes.notes:
"Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune" will release a new DEMO during Steam Next Fest  on June 13. At the same time, we will be launching a live broadcast event. It will start on June 13, at 10 a.m. (PT).

The current Steam Summer Sale will start on June 13 at 10 a.m. (PT) and end on June 20. During the event, everyone can download the DEMO for free.
This DEMO includes the first map in our game. Other than the basic tutorials, it will also depict the life of our main characters and what happened on their airship. The gameplay will take around 45 minutes to 1 hour.

Additionally, if you have any suggestions or find any bugs after you played our “Frontier Hunter” demo, feel free to contact us via Community or email, or discuss it with us on our official Discord server.

discord.com/invite/FtHEJ4EpE7
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1429500/discussions/

PLEASE NOTE:
Most of the core systems will be available in this DEMO. However, the tutorials for some of the features can only be accessed in the Early Access version. And unfortunately, the dress-up system is still not available at this point.
Meanwhile, our heroines will be live streaming the playtest in Live2D. And they will be revealing some interesting information in the Livestream. These are their Live2D narrators.

Erza Live2D in English: Stephanie Southerland
Erza Live2D in Japanese: Chihiro Furuichi
Ciara Live2D in Japanese: Yuhan
Nyano Live2D in Chinese: Nyano

Please add “Frontier Hunter” to your Steam wishlist to follow our latest update!

notes.title: Delayed Release + Plot dubbing demo
notes.notes:
Dear Hunters!
After 18 months of game development, we’re working our hardest to make sure that we bring you the best quality of gameplay possible.
Unfortunately, this means that we cannot meet our original planned release date and instead expect the game to come out in mid-2022. We’ve completed various key elements of the game including voice acting, character design, enemies, levels, items, skills etc., and are now in the process of putting it all together, piece by piece.
We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your continued support! We’ll continue to polish the game to perfection so that it will live up to everyone's expectations!

notes.title: Notice about mobile version port and 1.16 update.
notes.notes:
We have been busy transplanting mobile platforms recently, so the content of the PC version has not been updated for the time being, but during the process of transplantation and optimization, we found some better things that benefited the PC version.

1. A new SSAO (Ambient Occlusion) plug-in is set up for better performance and effects.
2. Switched to a new BLOOM effect script, which increased performance by 3 times and reduced CPU performance overhead by 0.12ms.
3, using the new FOG components. Reduced CPU performance overhead by 0.14ms.
5.Optimized the performance of real-time shadows.
4. Modified Traditional Chinese.

kind,
icesitruuna

notes.title: The official version is released! Update the announcement.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32909736/96b529792cd29649a47a5b5e613b3275d3a15d75.gif[/img]
The official version is released! Update the announcement.

After more than a year of content addition and modification, we decided to release the official version of v1.00. Thanks very much for the advice and help of enthusiastic players to enable us to complete the game.

After the release of the official version,we will continue to add new content,fix bugs and son on. So the follow-up is still worth looking forward to.

The following are the updates of the official version compared to the previous version:
1. Added a new basic weapon routine - Samurai sword, this is a very powerful weapon with two special weapon skills.
2. Re-do the guidance level for beginners, allowing the players to understand the game system more quickly.
3. Added a new set of clothes and hairstyles,which are designed for us by the enthusiastic player “Wu Jiang Lang Zi”.
4. Added the "Samurai sword" routine and the strengthen option for the chip of "Juhe Road".
5. Optimized the hitbox to improve the accuracy of the attack.
6. Fixed the bug with incorrect monster color of explosive ball in the second pass.
7. Fixed the bug that some skills might cause monsters to get stuck in the wall.
8. Fixed the bug that the last six STEAM achievements can not be achieved.
9. Fixed the bug of the license overlay.
10. Fixed the bug with the opposite setting of the handle RT and LT keys.
11. Fixed some text description errors on the interface.
12. Fixed the bug that could not be displayed and moved by certain probabilistic roles during transmission.
13. Fixed the bug that some skills could hit monsters but did not generate damage.
14. Fixed the bug that the number of items displayed in the scene was 0 after picking up.

Kind,
IceSitruuna

notes.title: v0.015 Update content and plans for our next version
notes.notes:
1. Add the function of the handle setting button
2. Optimize the description of some props in the game
3. Modify the BUG that the character in 3rd level can stand on the wall
4. Add the special effect for promoting the combo
5. Balance adjustment of partial chips
6. Fix the BUG that text in the skill table is beyond the interface box
7. Fill in the empty scene in the 2nd level
8. Will not be attacked again during the resurrection of "Angel Wings"
9. Fix the BUG happened when Tauren BOSS moves


The plan of next version
In November, we will have major updates. At that time, we will split the level, making one big level into two small levels (1-1 and 1-2). There are rest areas among small levels, and the process of each small level will be slightly longer.
This actually turns into six levels.
The conditions for obtaining a Gold Cup license will be changed, and this condition will no longer be "a monster that destroys the entire level."
In addition, we will add the part of the dress-up design. The heroine will have 1 set of replaceable garments, and more garments will be made in the future. These garments may need to meet certain conditions to be obtained.
Before the major version is released, there will be some small bugs that will continue to be fixed.

Please wait!


Sincerely,
IceSitruuna

XXX
YYY
XXYYY
XXYYXY
XYXY
XYYXY

↓↘→X or simplified ↓→X
